description: Lists every change to the caller's own repository in a space after a sequence number, deletions included. Paging from zero exports the whole repository.

main.description: Lists every change to the caller's own repository in a space after a sequence number, deletions included.

since.description: Return changes with a sequence number greater than this one; the change at since itself isn't repeated. 0 lists the whole repository.

limit.description: The most changes to return, from 1 to 500; any other value is refused with InvalidRequest. A page holds fewer when its records would pass 8 MiB, but always at least one change.

ops.description: The changes, oldest first, with only the latest state of each key.

cursor.description: The sequence number of the last change returned, or since when none were. Pass it as since to read the next page.

hasMore.description: Whether more changes follow this page.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: The space isn't the caller's own, answered exactly as for a missing record.

errors.name: CursorTooOld
errors.description: Deletions after since were purged, so paging on from it would miss them. List again from since=0.

change.description: One write or deletion in the repository. Deletions carry no cid or value.
